description:
Audits one page for an agent, paid per call: no account, no allowance and no tab.
The report of `POST /api/audit`, sold per call to agents. A request without payment gets the 402 with the price; a paid one gets the report in the same response, with the payment in `cobranca`. Nothing is stored: the report has no `id` and no tab. A page that does not open is not charged.
name: get_api_x402_audit
title: Get API X402 audit
